subject: Maplock: evaluation & close timeline — security acceptance inventory
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pioneerlend.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pioneerlend.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Maplock initial security asks and timeline

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the initial call this morning — good context. Procurement asked me to send a concise list of security/compliance deliverables we need during evaluation so we can align internal signoffs. Target commercial milestone: contract signed by 2027-06-28 (procurement deadline).

High-level asks (we can add detail in the MAP):
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) + control inventory
- Completed SIG/CAIQ self-assessment (preferably PDF)
- Draft DPA with any proposed deviations/redlines
- Data retention default settings + options for 1) 30-day; 2) 90-day; 3) custom enterprise retention with export/erase SLA
- Data residency options (US-only default, EU residency add-on)
- Key management: KMS/HSM options and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys
- Evidence access plan (how we hand off logs/audit artifacts during onboarding)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the SOC 2 report and SIG today, and whether a DPA redline is feasible within 48 business hours? If possible, please send a one-page MAP with owners and milestone dates that aligns to our procurement deadline.

Attachments: PioneerProcurementChecklist.pdf (stub)

Appreciate it — we want to keep close momentum.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement | Pioneer Lending
elena.ruiz@pioneerlend.com
+1 415-555-0172

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pioneerlend.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Maplock initial security asks and timeline

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the procurement deadline. We can support this cadence; below is what I can commit to immediately and proposed milestones for the MAP.

Quick commitments:
- SOC 2 Type II (latest) — we will deliver the report (redacted) today.
- SIG/CAIQ — completed self-assessment attached.
- DPA — legal can produce a redline within 48 business hours; we'll include standard carveouts for telemetry and operational logs, and outline retention choices.
- Data residency & retention — default US residency with optional EU tenancy. Default retention: 30 days. Enterprise option: 90 days or custom by contract; export + delete SLA documented.
- KMS/customer-managed keys — supported via our KM integrations (we'll include a short ops note).

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) 2027-06-01: Security package delivered (SOC 2 redacted + SIG, DPA draft stub) — owner: Kimberly Park (Redwood)
2) 2027-06-03: Procurement review complete; legal redline consolidated — owner: Jonas Weber (Redwood)
3) 2027-06-10: Technical evidence session & data-residency demo — owner: Marcus Lin (Redwood)
4) 2027-06-15: Final DPA sign & DocuSign prep — owner: Pioneer Legal / Redwood Legal
5) 2027-06-28: Contract signature target — mutual signoff

I'll attach a MAP draft (MAP_DRAFT_maplock_v1.docx) with acceptance criteria for each security gate and clear evidence owners. Can you confirm internal stakeholders on your side (legal, security contact) and whether procurement needs a DocuSign link earlier than 6/15?

Attachment: MAP_DRAFT_maplock_v1.docx (stub)
Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (stub)
Attachment: SIG_CAIC_self_assessment_2027.pdf (stub)

KG (Kimberly)
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Maplock — owners & evidence plan

Kimberly — internal note to capture owners and what to surface in the MAP draft before we send the finalized version. Reply inline to Elena once we confirm items below.

Actions I suggest we own: 
- Evidence pack: SOC 2 Type II (redacted) + control inventory (attach SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf) — Owner: Priyom Das (Solutions Engineering)
- SIG/CAIQ PDF + narrative for high-risk controls (e.g., data exfiltration controls) — Owner: Marcus Lin (Product)
- DPA redline (legal) + one-off retention clauses (30/90/custom) — Owner: Jonas Weber (Sales) -> Legal to produce redline (DPA_redline_kp_20270602.docx)
- Ops runbook for evidence access and export/delete SLA — Owner: Ops (I'll draft the runbook snippet)

Notes on retention: we should advertise 30-day default, offer a pre-approved 90-day enterprise tier (no extra engineering work), and document custom retention as an SOW/contract line item with an export+erase SLA (48 hours for exports, 14 days for complete logical deletion). If procurement pushes on escrow, we can offer a signed attestation and a SOC scope addendum, but full escrow isn't standard for hosted customers.

I'll bundle the SOC and SIG attachments into the MAP and mark evidence fields per milestone. Will @Jonas pick up DPA signoff and consolidate with Pioneer Legal?

--
Priyom Das
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pioneerlend.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pioneerlend.com>, LegalOps <legalops@pioneerlend.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Maplock: evaluation & close timeline — security acceptance inventory

Kimberly / Jonas — thanks, that schedule helps. A few clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- Procurement will not accept "redacted" SOC if it removes control IDs; we need the Type II bridge or redaction that preserves control mapping. Is that possible?
- For the DPA please call out the data categories we consider "customer content" vs "metadata". We'll need that for our privacy team.
- We require a one-page summary in the MAP showing signoff criteria per gate (SOC2 evidence, SIG complete, DPA executed, retention option selected).

Procurement deadline remains 2027-06-28. If Redwood can provide the MAP with named owners and the SOC with preserved control mapping by EOD 2027-06-03, we will proceed to internal legal review and aim for the June 28 signature.

Attached our procurement checklist to capture contract clauses we reference.

Thanks —
Elena

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pioneerlend.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Bcc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Maplock: evaluation & close timeline — security acceptance inventory

Elena — appreciate the clarity and the procurement checklist. We've locked down the items you requested and attached a finalized MAP with an acceptance-lane one-pager and preserved control mapping in the SOC bundle. Key calls out below: 

1) SOC 2 delivery: SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (redaction preserves control IDs) — Owner: Priyom Das. Delivery: 2027-06-01 (attached).
2) SIG/CAIQ: completed self-assessment attached in the MAP.
3) DPA: Redwood Legal has prepared a controlled redline; see attachment DPA_redline_kp_20270602.docx. We call out customer content vs metadata in Section 3.
4) Retention options: 30-day default; 90-day enterprise; custom by SOW with export+erase SLAs. We documented the export SLA (48 hours) and logical deletion window (14 days).
5) Evidence & ops: Priyom will host a 60-minute technical evidence session (demo of residency and export flows) on 2027-06-10.

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.redwood.com/envelopes/ENVELOPE-6823 (we'll enable once Pioneer Legal confirms final redline)

Attached: MAP_FINAL_maplock_v2.pdf (stub) — includes an acceptance matrix with explicit yes/no criteria per gate and named owners.

Next steps: 
- Pioneer legal provides DPA redline comments by 2027-06-07 (we'll consolidates and aim for 6/15 final).
- Technical evidence call scheduled 2027-06-10 — invite to follow from Priyom.

If this timeline works for you we will prepare the DocuSign after the 6/10 call and align signature target for 6/28.

Best,
Jonas Weber
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
